name: Sprint Retrospective Action Item PPTX
prompt:
There is an md file named BMS_Sprint_V2.4_Retrospective in the Agile_Tracking folder on the desktop; it is the sprint retrospective meeting minutes for version V2.4 of the BMS embedded team. Help me pull out all unfinished action items and turn them into a PPTX slide deck for tracking.

The action items in the minutes are in checkbox form: completed ones are checked “- [x]”, unfinished ones are “- [ ]”. I only want those that are unfinished and have a specific owner assigned via “@”.

The output presentation should be grouped by owner, with each person occupying one slide, the slide title using the owner's name, and the body listing that person's to-do tasks one by one. For task descriptions that carry the “[Urgent]” tag, set the font to red. The first page should be a data overview summarizing the total number of to-do tasks for each owner, sorted in descending order by count.

Minimalist style, solid-color background. Name the output file Action_Items_Tracking.pptx and save it in the Agile_Tracking directory.
